name: Lugh Belflare
source:
She is the daughter of a nobleman in Zeil Kingdom, which has been hostile to Yugudora Kingdom for many years. She met with Towa and his friends when she came to Yugudora as an international student.
Since black is regarded as a holy color in Zeil Kingdom, she is completely dressed in black, but it's thought to be an odd appearance in Salem, though.
Her family is so wealthy that she has a strange money sense, tending to solve everything with money.

[Translated from [url=http://products.web-giga.com/clarias/]official website[/url]]
